card.name: Half or couple after quantity words
card.fires_on: The word "half" after "a", "an additional" or "about a", and "of" after "a couple", when a rough amount of time or size follows. Also seen on a few number or unit pieces after "extra" or "about".

modes.label: half after a/additional
modes.description: "half" following "a" or "additional" in an approximate amount, such as half an hour or half-inch.
modes.example: No one should sit continuously for more than a<< half>> an hour without getting up and moving around

modes.label: couple of
modes.description: "of" right after "a couple" before a span of time.
modes.example: it might be well worth spending a couple<< of>> hours exploring the deep chambers and passages

modes.label: partial unit words
modes.description: Pieces of numbers or units after "extra" or a number, such as "two" or the start of a unit word.
modes.example: "An extra<< two>> or three years of psychosis-free functioning could
